zh-CN.title: 优化更新检查与历史加载

sections.title: 更新优化
items: 根据网络表现自动选择更快、更稳定的更新源，响应慢或失败时切换备用源
更新历史优先显示本地缓存并只获取新增版本，减少等待和重复请求

zh-CN.notice: 更新后请完整重启 Tabby。现有命令库和插件设置会保留。

en.title: Faster update checks and history loading

sections.title: Update improvements
items: Automatically prefer the faster and more reliable update source, switching to a fallback when requests are slow or fail
Show cached update history first and fetch only new versions to reduce waiting and repeated requests

en.notice: Fully restart Tabby after updating. Existing command libraries and plugin settings are preserved.
